Decide one direction-tier question after completed renewal B03/P72: what next bounded direction step, if any, is worth doing after two UP fitted comparisons followed by DOWN? I narrowly recommend considering one real B that compares learned renewal with its permanently frozen initial duration law, while retaining ordinary feedback as the native performance primary. Ending the current renewal sequence is a serious alternative. No new arm, master, card, scientific allocation or family disposition has been selected locally. This request seeks the original Convergence node's decision; P74 authorizes preparation and delivery of the question only. Later implementation or execution requires Root's new concrete command.

Read the preparation intake §§2–4 and machine facts before deciding. Preserve every independent training outcome: P70/7301 T−G +0.055673191348834944 (conditional evaluation SE 0.011556059794903147), T−H +0.05305453732049459, G−H −0.002618654028340355; P71/7401 T−G +0.024658177040921356 (SE 0.011145715505143731), T−H +0.03714831826363973, G−H +0.012490141222718373; P72/7501 T−G −0.03094711061890552 (SE 0.010056196158593048), T−H +0.021107100463981232, G−H +0.052054211082886756. Each fit had one matched training instance and 32 paired final episodes per T/G/H. The retained T−G episode signs are 25/7, 22/10 and 10/22 positive/negative. All native returns and all three contrasts/conditional SEs remain in the pinned summaries. The secondary three-fit mean +0.016461419256950254 and sample SD 0.043888031476388346 describe three endpoint differences, include finite evaluation noise and arose through outcome-informed B follow-ups. They are not a pooled primary, prospective three-seed confirmation or stable population uncertainty. Positive hover contrasts do not rescue P72's negative T−G.

Two prior UPs and positive sampled T−H in all three support asking a further discriminating question. P72's loss to feedback, alongside its larger G−H, is the strongest contradiction. Ordinary feedback can repeat a command itself and respond every primitive step to moving partners. It remains the strongest available legal null, while its tuned competence is unestablished. No tuned same-information current-host headroom record exists. This is a limitation and sequencing input, never a new launch prerequisite or reason by itself to stop the direction. Persistence, geometry, timing learning, gradient exposure/capacity and partner co-adaptation remain live explanations. Parameter/head movement or a duration-frequency statistic is not native value. Preserve older opening UPs, nulls and losses, the retained-policy/root-residual PARK and the current RECAST provenance; do not pool incompatible packages.

Option (a), recommended narrowly for your consideration: one newly trained matched instance of learned renewal T, an otherwise same renewal controller whose entire initialized duration head stays permanently frozen (call it F here only as prospective shorthand), and ordinary feedback G, plus fixed hover H. This is a real training comparison: F's velocity actor and critic still learn. In accepted policy.py arm_copy, the 67→32→2 duration head's final layer starts at zero. Keeping all 2242 head parameters frozen therefore keeps p(d=1)=p(d=4)=1/2 at every own expiry, independent of private history and selected command. This law is inherited from existing initialization, not fitted to observed duration rates or chosen from candidate probabilities. No new model call was needed to establish that source fact.

Keep T−G as the sampled native performance primary; T−F is a predeclared secondary discriminator for the possible value of learning the timing rule over simple stochastic persistence. Retain every arm's native values, signed paired differences, T−H/G−H/F−H and conditional episode SEs. A favorable T−F with adverse T−G would limit the comparison to that secondary package advantage; it is not overall gain. A within-MEI T−F is not equivalence. Freezing the head also changes trainable capacity, clipping/gradient exposure and co-adaptation, so even favorable results do not isolate pure information or timing causality. This control is not being demanded before ordinary learning; it is itself the proposed next bounded learning question.

Reuse B01 card §§2–3 and B03 card §§3–5 for the fixed five-UAV/50-user host, 256 primitive one-second steps, native reward sum divided by 256, legal 108-input private actor history, GRU64 and 136-input predecision critic. All agents still receive free primitive observations and update their recurrent history while held; only an owner's own expiry draws a new velocity and duration. Holding teammates draw neither. Preserve actual action suppression, selected duration labels under horizon censoring, fixed roster/reset identity, no terminal carryover/bootstrap, gamma=1 primitive return-to-go, zero entropy coefficient, current compound likelihood/owner masks and all-primitive-row loss denominator. In F the fixed categorical factor cancels between old/new likelihoods and has no gradient. Reuse common actor/critic initialization and the paired reset-panel law, with a distinct F action stream and no shared cross-arm action draws. No master value is proposed. No simultaneous team-decision barrier, sensing fee, extra sensor, interruption, new information privilege, roster change or additional decision-time normalizer is introduced.

The binding MARL structure is temporal abstraction/termination under multi-agent partial observability: own expiry amid ongoing team movement → legal private history and owned velocity → learned or input-independent persistence → actual movement/service and later free observations → masked actor/critic exposure and partner co-adaptation → full native team return. The proposal asks whether this changes a competent action package against G, not whether a statistic predicts returns.

The question-driven local reading in preparation §3 verifies real-corpus coverage. The current Inst-sci catalog has 190 records and eight lexical candidates. Rechecked UTE, Lee et al., AAAI 2024 (VS-0005 p1/e65, p6/e354, p7/e407): simple fixed repetition is relevant, Fixed Repeat j=4 is included, and it fails in many tested Atari games. This motivates a simple persistence comparison and warns against assuming it is competent. Our uniform law is an HMASD inference from initialization, not UTE's fixed-four algorithm or evidence of UAV gain. Reuse P67's verified ACAC own-completion passages and distinction from missing macro-observations; our actors keep primitive observations. My-lib's current published CLI reports only two synthetic fixtures, excluded from science evidence. The pinned facts preserve source paths, catalog/PDF digests, official-identity reuse and metadata warnings. No novelty claim or new UTE/ACAC machinery is proposed.

The prospective algorithm budget for (a) is one independent matched instance, three fitted actor/critic arms, each 512 complete 256-step training episodes, 256 two-episode rollouts and 1024 Adam calls at the existing learning rate/settings; 32 final episodes for each T/F/G/H, final checkpoints only. Thus 3×512×256 + 4×32×256 = 425984 native steps, 3072 Adam calls, 768 rollouts, 1664 explicit resets and 128 final evaluations. This is 1.5× training and 4/3× evaluation work versus an unchanged pair, 1.4857142857142858× native steps. Total parameters would be 203417, trainable 201175. There is no candidate/trajectory/controller-policy search, ensemble, tuning, extra checkpoint selection or nested evaluator.

For each renewal head, the existing forward-work law is 6×training-own-expiries + 2×final-own-expiries: 1003520–4014080 rows. Two heads together would be 2007040–8028160 rows, 4431544320–17726177280 dense forward multiply-adds, plus activation, recurrent/environment, backward and optimizer work. F may use the existing forward route but receives no head update. Bounds count actual possible own expiries, not policy enumeration. These operation ratios are not wall-time multipliers. Per fitted arm the other work is initialization + 131072 native/recurrent training steps + 1024 updates + 8192 learned-policy evaluation steps + publication, with G also carrying 8192 H steps. Measured renewal arm walls T/G are P70 160.45789840299403/135.36679288500454 s, P71 158.1893359690439/138.41656891599996 s and P72 204.3931929190294/172.94761272502365 s. Whole walls 304.85/306.04/390.73 s sum to 1001.62 s, or 333.8733333333334 s per valid fit; this excludes engineering, older regimes and aggregate CPU work. F's seconds and changed backward cost are unmeasured. Suggested caps for node consideration are 1800 s per complete arm and 3600 s whole study, with zero allocation here. A concrete cost refusal must reconsider the question and evidence needed, not create a cost pilot, higher cap, native rewrite or hidden preceding A.

The proposed effect scale is absolute MEI 0.01, retaining the meaningful native scale from prior cards; coverage component 0.7/50=0.014 is context, not a promised gain. Above +0.01 on the primary would be preliminary package support; inside ±0.01 no demonstrated point gain at that scale; below −0.01 adverse package evidence. Every outcome would end a single later allocation; no automatic additional seed, retry, extra evaluation, tuning or successor. You may narrow the proposal and must state its reading/stop at the honest B ceiling, without an exhaustive branching tree. Missing tuned headroom, exact maxima, support censuses, complete causal diagnosis and C-style confirmation are not prerequisites under evidence-spec §11.8.

Option (b): select no justified next bounded B from this question and state the smallest supported current-renewal sequence/family disposition. This is live because the third primary is adverse and the added learner buys only one new fitted comparison with remaining optimization/co-adaptation alternatives. It costs zero new scientific work. Do not turn that into whole-UCOPE impossibility, Portfolio lifecycle or priority action. Option (c): select one fourth unchanged T/G pair only if you can state a new bounded decision value. Its work is 286720 native steps, 2048 Adam calls and 96 final evaluations. It is not intrinsically forbidden, but it is not our default: P72's unchanged DOWN branch dropped unchanged continuation, another identical pair does not distinguish learned timing from simple persistence, and no run-until-positive policy or rescue by earlier means is justified. I favor (a) narrowly over (b), exposing this close call for rejection, rather than demanding stable superiority or exact diagnosis before any B.

Please decide the next direction step at declared B/EXPLORE class, with the strongest alternative and known work visible. If a costly diagnostic would be better, compare its decision value and work with the direct B and zero-work alternative before requiring it; finite/zero-learner work is not presumed cheap. Engineering scope §4: none requested. Later ordinary checks would be one affected semantic/primary suite within the existing 300 s allowance, with independent high-impact review when needed; no scientific validation invocation, profiler or repeated smoke. Existing 2000-line source/600-line runner limits and remote-first CPU FP32/one Torch thread route remain; fresh actual-node memory admission applies only to an explicitly allocated later invocation, not this consultation.

P67's accepted original-node decision is RECAST to own-expiry renewal, intake recasts: 1 with its recorded limits of historical coverage. Classify your present direction decision honestly as continuation, recast or the appropriately narrow no-successor disposition; naming a new controller must not evade the standing count. If you select another RECAST, the existing second-recast rule applies in later intake and Root's sequencing record; this request does not locally set it. C promotion, a new mechanism family outside this question, Portfolio lifecycle/priority/capacity and governance changes are not requested.

deliverable: Return one conclusion-first direction-tier decision on the next bounded step after P72: select a justified comparison within this question, or no ready successor with the smallest supported sequence/family scope. Explain the strongest support and contradiction, the serious alternatives, why the selected observation or zero-work choice is worth its known work, and the B claim ceiling. If selecting a future B, state the treatment/comparator, primary and secondary reading, complete work/cost boundary and all-outcome stop sufficiently for a later card; do not demand an exhaustive causal or confirmatory program. Classify any RECAST honestly under the standing count. This response changes no source, creates no card/master, executes no experiment, allocates no scientific invocation and makes no Portfolio decision. P74 application/implementation awaits the subsequent concrete Root command after full-response intake.
claim_ceiling: B/EXPLORE direction decision about native package performance and the value of one further fitted comparison on the fixed-five-UAV host. Historical three-fit dispersion is descriptive. No stable superiority/harm/equivalence, isolated timing/information/clipping/capacity causality, tuned headroom, transfer, C promotion, general impossibility or Portfolio lifecycle/priority/capacity change.
